name: Flea Barter Chance Percent
teaser: Percentage of barter/money offers in flea.
description_html:
Controls how much barter trade offer there are in flea market.

Config

Via config/config.json:

"barterChancePercent": 50,
"minRoubleCostToBecomeBarter": 1000, 
"itemCountMin": 1, // Min required barter items
"itemCountMax": 3, // Max required barter items
"priceRangeVariancePercent": 20 // Variance in price between offers

Installation

  • Drag and drop the content of the zip file in to SPT installation folder.
